# ffxf_plans (Data Source)

Lists FFXF Cloud compute plans, optionally filtered by region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

data "ffxf_plans" "catalog" {
  region = "montreal"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region` (String) Keep only plans offered in this region.

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) Plans available to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Intended workload.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk size in GiB.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MiB.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `port_mbps` (Number) Network port speed in Mbps.
- `prices` (Attributes List) Prices by currency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans--prices))
- `regions` (List of String) Available region slugs.
- `slug` (String) Stable plan slug.
- `status` (String) Plan availability status.
- `traffic_tb` (Number) Included traffic in TiB, when metered.
- `vcpu` (Number) Virtual CPU count.

<a id="nestedatt--plans--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans.prices`

Read-Only:

- `annual` (String) Annual price.
- `currency` (String) Currency code.
- `hourly` (String) Hourly price as a decimal string.
- `hourly_month_equivalent` (String) Monthly equivalent of hourly billing.
- `hourly_stopped` (String) Hourly stopped-machine price, when offered.
- `monthly` (String) Monthly price.
- `setup_fee` (String) One-time setup fee.
